item.title: Write My Talking Sale Pitch

turns.text: Make this photo of me say something about our sale. You write the line—keep it upbeat and don't invent discounts, dates or products. An 8-second square talking video, friendly male English voice, no captions.

item.tests: Tests autonomous short sale-copy writing and talking-head output without inventing offer details or asking for a script.

answer_sheet.Source person: Me, the grey-haired man in portrait-man.jpg.
answer_sheet.Sale details: Mention our sale generally; do not invent discounts, dates or products.

must_haves: The talking presenter remains recognizably the grey-haired man in the attached photo.
An audible, coherent, agent-written English line invites viewers to check out the sale.
The speech contains no invented discount, sale date, product, or other specific offer claim.
The man's mouth visibly moves in sync with the spoken line.
The result is one square, 8-second video with a friendly male voice and no captions.

turns.text: Make this photo of me say something about our sale. You write the line—keep it upbeat and don't invent discounts, dates or products. An 8-second square talking video, friendly male English voice, no captions.
turns.agent:
I couldn't make the video. Your Magic Hour account doesn't have enough credits, so it turned down the request. Nothing was created.

**The line I wrote** (upbeat, with no discounts, dates or products):
> "Hey everyone! Our sale is on right now, so come take a look and find something you love. I can't wait to see you there!"

**The settings I used:** your photo (it's already square), 8 seconds, spoken in English, no captions, at 480p on the ltx-2.5 model, which is the free plan's option. This tool doesn't let me pick a voice. It chooses one to match the photo, so a friendly male voice is likely but I can't guarantee it.

A shorter video would cost fewer credits, but I didn't cut it down because you asked for 8 seconds. To go ahead you could:
1. **Add credits** to your Magic Hour account (top up or buy a credit pack), and I'll run the same request again.
2. **Make it shorter**, for example 5 seconds with a shorter line like "Hey everyone! Our sale is on now. Come find something you love!" It might still need more credits than you have.
3. **Send your own voice recording** of the line. I'd use a different tool that makes your photo speak your recording. That still costs credits, but you'd get exactly the voice you want.

Tell me which one you'd like, or if you want the line changed.

I'm checking the square output against the 1024x1024 image. plan_request isn't tied to create_spoken_ad_video, so I'm weighing create_talking_photo against create_video_from_image.
